program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v)
    frames = []
    for color in counts:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        if not (all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1+1))):
            continue
        if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(r0+1, r1) for c in range(c0+1, c1)):
            continue
        frames.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1))
    frame_colors = {f[0] for f in frames}
    dot_counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                         if grid[r][c] and grid[r][c] not in frame_colors)
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for border, r0, r1, c0, c1 in frames:
        for c in range(c0, c1+1):
            out[r0][c] = out[r1][c] = border
        for r in range(r0, r1+1):
            out[r][c0] = out[r][c1] = border
        ir, ic = r0+1, c0+1
        nfill = sum((r+c)%2 == 0 for r in range(ir,r1) for c in range(ic,c1))
        fill_color = next(color for color, n in dot_counts.items() if n == nfill)
        for r in range(ir, r1):
            for c in range(ic, c1):
                if (r+c)%2 == (ir+ic)%2:
                    out[r][c] = fill_color
    return out
'''
